references.text: The whole of Jotham's fable about the trees that wanted to anoint a king over themselves, where the olive tree, the fig tree, and the vine decline, but the thornbush accepts
Israel's desire to have a king over them, like other nations, reflects the same theme of choosing a ruler
The parable about the cedar tree where the Lord plants a branch that will become a great tree uses similar imagery about trees and kingship
The olive tree as a symbol of the righteous who thrive in God's house, connected to the role of the olive tree in the fable
The oil that makes the face shine and the wine that gladdens the human heart refers to the products of the olive tree and the vine mentioned in the fable
